connector.name: Gemsift MCP
connector.registryDescription: AI resume triage for recruiters. Query your candidate pool from Claude or ChatGPT.
connector.summary: Hosted at gemsift.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the erashev-fedor account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
